title: Internal Audit Services for SMEs and Growing Companies
summary: Risk-based internal audit of purchase-to-pay, order-to-cash, payroll, inventory and treasury, with an action plan and follow-up.
metaTitle: Internal Audit Services for SMEs and Growing Companies
metaDescription: Risk-based internal audit for SMEs: walk-throughs and testing of purchase-to-pay, order-to-cash, payroll, inventory and treasury, with rated findings and follow-up.
heroIntro: A scoped, risk-based review of your key finance cycles, with findings rated by risk and an action plan with owners and dates.
overview: Internal audit gives owners and boards independent assurance that processes work as intended. We agree a risk-based plan with management, test the cycles that matter and report root causes, not just symptoms. Engagements run quarterly or annually.
whatWeDo: Agree a risk-based audit plan with management.
Walk through and test purchase-to-pay, order-to-cash, payroll, inventory and treasury.
Rate findings by risk, with root causes.
Prepare an action plan with owners and dates.
whoFor: Owner-led businesses that want independent assurance.
Companies with lenders or investors asking about controls.
Groups with multiple locations or entities.
duration: Scoped engagement. Quarterly or annual cycles.
note: Independence comes first. We offer internal audit only to clients whose books we do not maintain, or through a separate team with disclosure and safeguards.

faqs.q: Can you do internal audit if you keep our books?
faqs.a: Not directly. To protect independence, we offer internal audit only to clients whose books we do not maintain, or through a separate team with disclosure and safeguards.
